Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Specification for Volumetric Karl Fischer Autoti trator 1. The instrument should be a standalone type with a colour touch screen i nterface for operation. 2. The instrument should be capable of performing moisture analysis by volum etric Karl Fischer Titration. 3. The instrument should have the capability to determine moisture in the rang e from100 ppm to 100%. 4. The instrument should have a live titration curve display. 5. The instrument should have a built-in magnetic stirrer. 6. The instrument should have the facility to store at least 100 methods. 7. The instrument should have the facility to generate PDF reports with date an d timestamp and store them in the USB memory stick connected to the instrum ent.

8. The instrument should have a motor-driven piston burette, with a high b urette resolution of 1/20,000 of burette volume or better. The burette shoul d comply with DIN EN ISO 8655-6 standard. 9. The instrument should have the possibility of connecting burettes of volume 5, 10,20 and 50 mL, allowing maximum flexibility if required. 10 mL burette sho uld be quoted along with the instrument. 10.The instrument should be provided along with a solvent pump used for addit ion of methanol and removal of titrated solvent without opening the titration ve ssel. 11.The instrument should be provided along with the double pin platinum elect rode and other accessories like closed titration vessel, tubing, etc., required for Karl Fischer volumetric titration. 12.Suitable oven sampler for extraction of moisture from samples which are no t soluble and reactive should be available if required. The oven sampler should have the following specifications. a) Should have a temperature range from ambient to 250 °C, with liv e temperature display. b) Digital gas flow monitoring with built-in air pump. c) Should have the facility to customize the oven as per the vials used. d) Drying flasks as well as comprehensive accessories comprising sa mple vials, septa, etc. 13.Live data entries like sample weight, stop criteria should be possible when t he titration is in progress. 14.The instrument should have the facility to lock date and time using a passw ord. 15.The instrument should have an Ethernet facility to send the data to PC/LIMS . 16.The instrument should have the facility to send and receive remote signals f rom other instruments 17.The instrument should have the following technical specifications i. Polarization current: 1 to 100 μA or better ii. Potential measuring range: 0 to 3500 mV or better iii. Potential measuring resolution: 0.1 mV 18.All the required accessories for the moisture analysis should be provided alo ng with the instrument. . 9.
